title: Picnics, Milneburg and race at the lakefront camps
summary: Howard talks about picnics and playing at Milneburg, including a white nightclub, and whether the camps were Black or white.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Did you ever play many or go to many when you were a kid? I played a lot of picnics.
I played a lot of picnics this year. We never hear about those usually. In the country? Yeah, in the country. That's where they go.
A year lately they've been going Nine Mile Point. Where is that now? That's right down here in Chile.
Down the lake? Yeah, down in Chile. And La Place. That's been a lot of them up there. A lot of them up there? Yeah. And the pigs?
Where is the pigs? Where is the pigs?
That's right down here in Chile.
Down in the lake?
Yeah, down in Chile. And La Place. That's been a lot of them up there. A lot of them up there? Yeah.
There's room after another question. Did you ever play at Millenburg or go out there?
Yeah. I played Millenburg.
Okay, we're talking about the island of Millenburg. Did you ever play there before they tore it down?

Yeah, I played there when they had all of those camps out there. I played out there with Jake Carey on the drum and I played with my arn band out there in Millenburg. Then I played at a white nightclub out there.
Was there a nightclub? They had a nightclub out there. I thought most of these little camps out over the water.

Oh yeah, well I mean they had camps out on top of that's colored, but I don't know, but we, let's see, a fellow called Hickman, Albert Boyd Banks, Louis Gallo. Louis Gallo played the piano. I forgot we played the drum. Anyway, we played out there on the weekends, quite a while. I played a trumpet then.
Tell me, some people have told me that Millenburg was part colored, or one time it was white and then they changed it to colored, or was there any?
Well I don't know anything about that.
Well I don't know anything about that.

I thought it was colored. I mean at the time. The places you played were colored? No, the one I played, they had a camp out there, a night, I mean not a camp, it was a nightclub. Yeah. And that was strictly for white, and I had to operate when I had a muse at the weekend, you see. Yeah.
And uh. These places out over the water, those were colored people, hadn't they?
Yeah, colored people. Well you see, it's like down Seabrook, out them places, that's where the white camp.
